description:
FILED s543a (Opus, 2026-11-16), found by the line-track flip's probe 3 (scratch/s543a/probes/p3-run.pl, p3b, p3/sym.pl in the s543a worktree).  PRE-EXISTING in every build (base c5f618f2 default answers the same for $INC, __FILE__ and an explicit die); the s543a flip extends it to runtime-raised dies and caller/Carp lines in such a module.

perl names a module by the @INC entry AS SPELLED plus the relative path: `-Ilib`, `use lib 'lib'` or `push @INC, 'lib'` give `$INC{'M3.pm'} = 'lib/M3.pm'`, a die in it `at lib/M3.pm line 9.`, a symlinked entry `use lib 'lnk'` gives `lnk/M3.pm`.  PCL names it by an ABSOLUTE REAL path: `/abs/dir/lib/M3.pm` in all four spellings, the symlink resolved.

PROBE (p3/rel.pl, run from its directory):
    use lib "lib"; use M3;
    print "INC=$INC{q{M3.pm}} file=", M3::file(), "\n";    # M3::file is __FILE__
    eval { M3::divz() }; print "mod-div: $@";
  perl: INC=lib/M3.pm file=lib/M3.pm / ... at lib/M3.pm line 9.
  PCL : INC=/abs/.../lib/M3.pm file=/abs/.../lib/M3.pm / ... at /abs/.../lib/M3.pm line 9.

Where: the require search or lib.pm's shim absolutises the entry (one of `use lib`, `-I` handling in pcl, and the runtime's @INC walk -- `push @INC, "lib"` also comes out absolute, so the walk itself merges).  A program comparing `__FILE__` / `$INC{}` / a die's file with a relative string differs.  Note for a fix: the module cache embeds the path the transpile was given (s543a put the spelling in the key when it is not the true name), so a relative spelling is cacheable.  Size: the change is in the @INC walk; the board's and the sweep's populations must be re-run because $INC values are printed by tests.
subject: A module found through a relative or symlinked @INC entry is named by its absolute real path ($INC, __FILE__, die locations); perl keeps the spelling (lib/M.pm, lnk/M.pm) -- pre-existing, every build
